name: ProgressBar
description: A linear progress indicator for operations with a known or unknown completion percentage. Supports a determinate mode (value 0–100) and an indeterminate mode for operations of unknown duration. Fully accessible via ARIA progressbar role.

notes: aria-valuemin is always 0 and aria-valuemax is always 100.
aria-valuenow is set to the value prop when determinate; omitted when indeterminate.
aria-label must be provided via the label prop to give the progress bar an accessible name.
When prefers-reduced-motion is set, the indeterminate animation is disabled and the bar shows at 50% width instead.

value.description: Current progress value between 0 and 100. Ignored when indeterminate=true.

indeterminate.description: When true, the bar animates continuously to indicate an operation of unknown duration.

size.description: Height of the progress bar track. sm=4px, md=8px.

label.description: Accessible label applied as aria-label. Always required for screen-reader users.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outermost wrapper element.

do: Always provide a label for screen readers.
Use indeterminate when the operation duration is unknown.
Clamp the value prop between 0 and 100 before passing it in.
dont: Do not pass a value outside 0–100 — results are undefined.
Do not use a ProgressBar for multi-step flows — use ProgressSteps instead.
Do not apply inline styles — use the className prop and extend via CSS tokens.
